observed.note: 14.7 Mm³ of frozen moraine failed into the lake at 22:13:20 IST; displacement wave ~20 m; ~50 Mm³ (about half the lake) released; peak flow height ~11 m about 1 km downstream.
observed.source: Sattar et al. 2025, Science, doi:10.1126/science.ads2659 (via Eos / The Landslide Blog)

observed.note: The flood reached Chungthang about 00:35 on 4 Oct (≈ 2 h 22 min after the failure) — the "reported arrival time" Sattar et al. compare their model with; how it was recorded is not stated. The often-quoted 00:30 is THEIR HEC-RAS result (water only, n = 0.05), not an observation. The 60 m Teesta-III dam was destroyed.
observed.source: Sattar et al. 2025, Science, doi:10.1126/science.ads2659 (accepted manuscript, eprints.whiterose.ac.uk/224098)

observed.note: MODELLED peak in Sattar et al. 2025 (HEC-RAS, water phase): 5,340 m³/s within ~6 min of the first arrival, 9 m deep, 9 m/s — a fourth reconstruction beside 7,355 and 10,282–14,673.
MODELLED peak (HEC-HMS/HEC-RAS reconstruction calibrated to the gauged peak at Gazoldoba); other studies give 10,282–14,673 m³/s here. No gauge measured it.
